translation.en: The earth is wide.
The farmer watered the land.
The child sat on the ground.
The colour of the earth is red.
The witness to the sale is truthful.
The judge questioned the witness to the sale.
The judge trusted the witness to the sale.
The words of the witness to the sale are clear.
The path of truth is clear.
The man knew the path.

translation.bs: Mladić je ostao na putu dobra.
translation.en: The young man remained on the path of good.
The end of the path is near.
Permission is necessary.
The student asked for permission.
The guest came in with permission.
Asking for permission is good manners.
The strength of the wind is severe.
The grandfather lost his strength.

translation.bs: Čovjek je svom snagom gurnuo vrata.
translation.en: The man pushed the door with force.
The source of strength is food.

translation.bs: Prvaci su se okupili u dvorcu.
translation.en: The chiefs met in the palace.
The king consulted the chiefs.
The minister sat with the chiefs.
The chiefs' opinion is important.
The army advanced.
The king gathered the army.
The young man joined the army.
The commander of the army is wise.
The magician gladdens the children.
The children watched the magician.

translation.bs: Djeca su se smijala s čarobnjakom.
translation.en: The children laughed with the magician.
The magician's stick is long.
The father works in the factory.
The teacher thanked the parents.
The teacher spoke with the father.
The parents' house is near.
The illness is prevalent in the village.
The doctor treated the illness.
The doctor asked about the illness.
The cause of the illness is known.
The worker builds the house.
The manager thanked the workers.
The merchant paid the money to the worker.
The worker's hand is strong.
The poor man is hungry.
The doctor helped the poor.
The mother gave the food to the poor man.
The poor man's clothes are old.
The drink is cold.
The mother offered the drink to the guests.

translation.bs: Dijete je stavilo šećer u piće.
translation.en: The child put the sugar in the drink.
The taste of the drink is sweet.
Idle talk is annoying.
The wise man avoided idle talk.
The students stopped the idle talk.
The harm of idle talk is clear.
The thunderbolt struck the tree.
The traveler saw the thunderbolt.

translation.bs: Djeca su se uplašila od gromova.
translation.en: The children were afraid of the thunderbolts.
The sound of the thunderbolt is strong.
Affection strengthens friendship.
The neighbor showed affection.

translation.bs: Učitelj se odnosio prema učenicima s naklonošću.
translation.en: The teacher treated the students with affection.
The strength of the affection is clear.
The dream was realized.

translation.bs: Dijete je ispričalo san svojoj majci.
translation.en: The child related the dream to his mother.

translation.bs: Dijete je vidjelo mačku u snu.
translation.en: The child saw a cat in the dream.
The explanation of the dream is difficult.
Indecency corrupts society.
The youth rejected indecency.

translation.bs: Otac je upozorio svoje sinove na nemoral.
translation.en: The father warned his sons of indecency.
The danger of indecency is great.
The she-camel drinks the water.
The farmer milked the she-camel.
The merchant traveled on a she-camel.
The milk of the she-camel is useful.
The loads are in the truck.
The workers transported the loads.

translation.bs: Radnik je stavio uže na terete.
translation.en: The worker put the rope on the loads.
The weight of the loads is large.
The donkey is patient.
The farmer ties the donkey.
The child sat on the donkey.
The donkey's owner is a farmer.
The body needs rest.
The mother covered the child's body.
The medicine enters the body.
The body's temperature is elevated.
The war finally stopped.
People hate war.
The soldier returned from the war.
The end of the war is near.
The child slept early.
The mother carried the child.
The grandfather read a story to the children.
We heard the voices of the children.
The owner sold the house.
The guest thanked the owner of the house.
The neighbor spoke with the owner.

translation.bs: Ime vlasnika je napisano na vratima.
translation.en: The owner's name is written on the door.
The news spread quickly.

translation.bs: Djed je pročitao vijesti u novinama.
translation.en: The grandfather read the news in the newspaper.
The family listened to the news.
The source of the news is known.
Feeding the poor is a beautiful act.
The school organized the feeding of the students.

translation.bs: Mladići su pomogli u hranjenju putnika.
translation.en: The young men helped in feeding the travelers.
Feeding time is in the evening.

translation.bs: Izdajnik se pokajao zbog svog djela.
translation.en: The traitor regretted his deed.
People do not respect the traitor.

translation.bs: Otac je upozorio svog sina na izdajnika.
translation.en: The father warned his son of the traitor.
The traitor's face was sad.
The wolf howled in the night.
The hunter saw the wolf.
The rabbit was afraid of the wolf.
We heard the sound of the wolf.
The mountain pass was narrow.
The travelers crossed the mountain pass.
The soldiers walked in the mountain pass.

translation.bs: Put kroz klanac bio je težak.
translation.en: The road of the mountain pass was difficult.
The division was fair.
The brothers accepted the division.

translation.bs: Partneri su se složili o podjeli.
translation.en: The partners agreed on the division.
The method of the division is clear.
The downpour fell on the city.
The children saw the downpour.
The farmer spoke about the downpour.
The sound of the downpour is strong.
Secrecy is important in commerce.
The manager requested secrecy.
The employee promised secrecy.
The reason for the secrecy is known.
The mistake was small.
The teacher corrected the mistake.
The child learned from the mistake.
The reason for the mistake is clear.
The hill is green.

translation.bs: Djeca su se popela na brežuljak.
translation.en: The children climbed the hill.
The family sat on the hill.
We arrived at the top of the hill.
The meadow is full of flowers.
The rain watered the meadow.
The cow slept in the meadow.
The flowers of the meadow are beautiful.
The increase in prices is clear.
The workers requested an increase.
The worker was happy about the increase.
The reason for the increase is known.
Parting is difficult for the mother.
The two friends hated parting.
The child cried from the parting.
The day of parting is sad.
